title: solve.substitution.requested (v1) -- stage 2
description: DRAFT by osovyk for review; owner TBD. timetable -> solver, one job per date of an absence (spec §06, §12). Stage 2 engine: ADR 2026-11-15-solver-substitution-engine (contracts 0.5.0). The solver proposes, it never decides: steps 1 (free teacher), 2 (rebuild of `date`), 3 (neighbour dates of iso_week), the rest self_study; the answer is solve.started, then solve.completed with data.substitution (see solve.status.v1.json). timetable builds the effective week and validator-lib (newConflicts) gives the verdict. Solvers before 0.4.0 read only the envelope and data.job_id and answer at once with solve.completed {status: MODEL_INVALID, error.code: unsupported_job_type}, without solve.started (ADR 2026-11-15-solver-substitution-unsupported). A broken message is copied to solve.substitution.requested.dlq: without school_id or data.job_id it is only copied; with them it is first answered with MODEL_INVALID (invalid_payload or unsupported_schema_version). not_before: ADR 2026-11-04-solver-kafka-mvp (the engine never reads the clock). absences, non_school_dates, allow_support_moves and approved_substitutions[].kind/moved_to are optional (0.5.0), so a 0.4.x producer stays valid.
$comment: 0.5.0 is additive. Two deviations from spec v24 §06 (line 613), accepted in ADR 2026-11-15-solver-substitution-engine: absences[] of all teachers of the week (ids only) and non_school_dates[].

lessons.description: Lessons of the absent teacher on `date` to cover.

not_before.description: Step 3 moves lessons only to dates >= not_before ("today" in Europe/Kyiv when the job was created).

iso_week.description: Window boundary for step 3, e.g. 2026-W45. The step 3 window is the dates of this ISO week that are school_days, >= not_before, not in non_school_dates, minus `date` itself.

template.description: Timetable in force on `date`: published main, or the alert template if an activation applies.

approved_substitutions.description: Already approved substitutions (overlays) of the window, of every kind: the solver treats them as part of the baseline week. kind (0.5.0) defaults to teacher, the only shape before 0.5.0.

kind.description: 0.5.0. teacher = another teacher; moved = the lesson goes to moved_to; self_study; cancelled (chosen only by a person).

teacher_id.description: The substitute; required for kind=teacher only.

absences.description: 0.5.0, deviation from v24 §06 (ADR 2026-11-15-solver-substitution-engine). All absences of the ISO week, including those of absent_teacher_id (also on `date`): the solver never proposes a teacher in a lesson he is absent from, and step 2 needs the absent teacher's own lesson_nos. lesson_nos null = the whole date. Ids only: no reason, no name (personal-data minimisation, Law 2297-VI art. 6). Missing = only absent_teacher_id is absent, on absence_dates, the whole day (so step 2 has no moves).

non_school_dates.description: 0.5.0, deviation from v24 §06 (ADR 2026-11-15-solver-substitution-engine). Holidays and other non-working dates of the ISO week: no lessons are held, they are not in the step 3 window, and their lessons do not count to the weekly limit. [] = no such dates. Missing = step 3 is off (the job stops after step 2), which is how timetable turns step 3 off.

allow_support_moves.description: 0.5.0. false (default): only lessons of absent_teacher_id move, only into slots free in the template plus approved_substitutions, never into a slot freed by another proposal of the same job, and every proposal is a lesson of `lessons`. true (after the defence): steps 2 and 3 may also move other teachers' lessons (chains of swaps); those rows come back as kind=moved outside `lessons`. timetable sends true only once it applies such rows.
